orderConfirmation.title: Order confirmation in Messenger
orderConfirmation.hint: When you create an order from a Messenger conversation, the customer gets its summary with Confirm, Change and Cancel buttons. A tap on Confirm confirms the order; orders nobody confirms appear under To call on the Orders page.

followUp.title: Follow up when a customer goes quiet
followUp.hint: When a customer asks about a product, gets an answer and then says nothing, the AI agent writes them one short, friendly nudge. It checks stock again first, and never offers a discount or takes an order on its own.
followUp.enable: Send one follow-up to customers who go quiet before ordering
followUp.enableHint: At most one per conversation, only between 9am and 9pm, and only inside Messenger's 24-hour reply window. Never after an order, an escalation, a pause, a snooze, your own reply, or if the customer asked not to be messaged. In draft mode it waits in the inbox for you.
